title: Root Amputation; a viable alternative to tooth extraction: A case series F. I
authors: Weboko, S. Lelei, Z. Rop, S. M. Toka, M. Ochieng, F. J. Chemase and M. N. Makhanu. East African Medical Journal Vol. 101 No. 11 November 2024
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone plus (bovine bone with hyaluronate) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This case series presents four cases of root amputation procedures carried out on maxillary first molars with insurmountable impediments in either of the buccal roots. The untreatable roo ts were amputated salvaging the remaining portion of the strategically important teeth” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
